title: Wendell and the Debt
author: Juniper Galloway
blurb: Zephyrine Halloran, a whistle-blower living under four names, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
